skills.name: chapters
skills.one_line_purpose: Author a chapter's on-screen copy in one Markdown file per chapter.
skills.description: Edit any word the audience reads without computing timecodes: one Markdown file per chapter, with per-line timing derived from readability. Use when writing or rewriting chat pills, red splashes, or title, status and credit cards.

skills.name: farm
skills.one_line_purpose: Run frame-touching encodes on the remote Kubernetes farm.
skills.description: Run frame-touching encodes on the remote farm. Use when the cluster is reachable and you need a Prod encode, a megacut segment, or another long render.

skills.name: testing
skills.one_line_purpose: Keep the offline suite the whole gate, and diagnose checks red only in CI.
skills.description: The suite is the gate. Use when a test passes locally and fails in CI, when adding a check, or when anything resolves a binary, font, or path outside the repo.

skills.name: audio
skills.one_line_purpose: Preserve source fidelity and enforce delivery audio headroom.
skills.description: Preserve source fidelity and enforce delivery audio headroom. Use when sourcing a bed, measuring a deliverable, or deciding whether a file meets the repo's audio standard.

skills.name: casting
skills.one_line_purpose: Bind visible Destiny characters to verified contributor identities.
skills.description: Bind visible Destiny characters to verified contributor identities. Use when adding or reviewing lead bindings, monthly ensemble credits, or cast-derived permissions.

skills.name: editing
skills.one_line_purpose: Build and revise cuts from indexed footage without inventing shots.
skills.description: Build and revise cuts from indexed footage without inventing shots. Use when making story outlines or renders from indexed segments.

skills.name: megacut
skills.one_line_purpose: Assemble finished acts into the canonical programme without re-editing them.
skills.description: Assemble finished acts into the canonical programme without re-editing them. Use when joining delivered cuts into one continuous video and verifying the joins.

skills.name: plates
skills.one_line_purpose: Render authored identity and dialogue cards without inventing copy.
skills.description: Render authored identity and dialogue cards without inventing copy. Use when burning Guardian nameplates, chat cards, or full-frame cards onto a video.

skills.name: production
skills.one_line_purpose: Take approved video work from issue brief to delivered artifact.
skills.description: Take approved video work from issue brief to delivered artifact. Use when an issue needs to run from brief, through indexing or rendering, to a file in the delivery workspace.
